summary: The main article describes the synthesis and application of dicyanopyrazine (DPZ) derivatives as organic photoredox catalysts. It includes 3 tables for electrochemical data and reaction optimization, and 7 figures illustrating catalyst structures, absorption spectra, and proposed reaction mechanisms.
